_selfVerification: Did the harness review the running app in a browser (from the run log)? pass = reviewed and succeeded · partial = tried but failed · fail = no attempt. Note what it actually did.
selfVerificationNotes: fail/fail on browser review, but it did MORE than a bare build check. From the run log: it repeatedly ran `tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm build`; ran a Node script computing Earth's position at J2000 (verifying r~0.983 au) and every planet's r vs a; verified the asteroid .bin byte-alignment (sentry offset); and served dist/ with `vite preview` then curl'd `/` and `/data/manifest.json` (checking HTTP 200 + payload). It also ran `git status --short data/` and `test ! -w data/asteroids.json` to confirm data/ was untouched. BUT it never launched a real browser: no headless Chrome/Playwright, no console-error capture, no screenshots, no DOM interaction. curl of the HTML shell does not execute the React/WebGL app, so neither console errors nor the rendered display were ever reviewed. consoleReview = fail, displayReview = fail.
_grade: Marks: pass | good | partial | poor | fail | na | null(ungraded). See RUBRIC.md. Score is computed by pnpm compile. Usability marks were filled by Mike's visual pass; everything else graded from code, build, headless-browser console capture, and the run log.
